_comment_path: Copy this file to .databricks/bundle/<target>/variable-overrides.json -- DAB auto-loads that EXACT path (a repo-root copy is NOT picked up). On a fresh clone that folder does not exist yet: run `mkdir -p .databricks/bundle/dev` first (match your -t target).
_comment_optional: Keys above are the minimal required set. The keys below are common OPTIONAL overrides (node type, cluster policy, serverless budget policy, alternate app name). JSON has no comments, so the _comment_* keys are documentation only -- DAB ignores unknown top-level keys, but delete them if your tooling is strict. Delete any optional key you do not need. For the FULL advanced set (run_as SP, OBO user_api_scopes, app_permissions, Lakebase) copy variable-overrides.advanced.example.json instead.
_comment_node_type: Job-cluster node type -- must match your cloud. AWS i3.2xlarge (default); Azure Standard_D8s_v3; GCP n2-highmem-8.
_comment_model: LLM endpoint used by BOTH the jobs and the app (comments, PI, domain, agents). Default databricks-claude-sonnet-4-6. Override to point at a different Foundation Model or provisioned-throughput endpoint.
_comment_cluster_policy: CLUSTER POLICY: a plain string ID, wired into both classic job clusters (metadata_job_cluster + lakebase_job_cluster). Left EMPTY here so copying this file verbatim gives a safe policy-free deploy; to apply a policy set policy_id to your cluster policy ID (e.g. "001DD81A49229D7C", from Settings > Compute > Cluster policies). Requires Databricks CLI >= 1.10.0, which drops an empty policy_id before deploy (older CLIs send "" and the Jobs API rejects it). For advanced cluster tuning you can instead override the WHOLE metadata_job_cluster complex variable -- copy its default from variables.yml.
_comment_budget_policy: Serverless budget policy ID for cost attribution on serverless jobs (Settings > Compute > Serverless usage policies). Plain string; empty (default) IS accepted at job level. Left EMPTY here so verbatim copy is safe; set it to your budget policy UUID to attribute serverless cost.
_comment_app_name: Alternate app name. app_name_suffix appends to BOTH the app display name and the job-name prefix, so multiple instances can coexist in one workspace (the app is a singleton by name). e.g. "-dev". Honored by grant_app_permissions.sh too.
_comment_app_lifecycle: Leave as {} (the safe default, shown below) -- works on BOTH deploy engines; the app is started by `bundle run dbxmetagen_app` (deploy.sh / Option 1 do this) or the UI run icon. For a ONE-STEP deploy where a single `bundle deploy` also deploys the app source and starts it, change this to {"started": true} -- but ONLY on the DIRECT engine (workspace UI + fresh CLI). Do NOT set `started` if your bundle state is on the TERRAFORM engine (an older deploy.sh/CLI lineage): terraform rejects it at build time.
